workflow.heading: How we build
workflow.intro: How a business problem becomes a system that runs: workflow analysis, architecture, build, deployment, and the tuning that follows.

phases.name: Discover
phases.title: Map the Workflow. Find the AI Opportunity.
phases.body: We sit with the operation, trace where work actually slows down, and identify which steps an AI system can take over without breaking the process around them.
items: Feasibility, ROI modeling, and model selection
System architecture blueprint and delivery timeline

image.alt: Discover: a flat app window on orange showing a six-step workflow map with the fourth step highlighted in orange as the bottleneck, above a bar breakdown and a rising trend line

phases.name: Design
phases.title: Design the System. Define the Guardrails.
phases.body: We turn that map into a system architecture: agent behaviour, tool access, escalation paths, and the interfaces the people around the system will actually use.
items: Human-in-the-loop interaction design and escalation paths
Agent architecture, tool access, and permission boundaries
Working prototypes validated against the real workflow

image.alt: Design: a flat app window on orange showing an AI agent connected to a database, a document and an integration inside a dashed orange guardrail with a padlock, and an orange arrow handing over to a person outside it

phases.name: Build
phases.title: Build It. Connect It. Ship It.
phases.body: We build the system against your real data and real tools: agent pipelines, retrieval, integrations, and the infrastructure it runs on.
items: Application layer, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations
Agent pipelines, custom RAG, and private model fine-tuning
Access controls, automated testing, and strict type safety

image.alt: Build: a flat app window on orange with a dark code editor on the left and a four-step build pipeline on the right, three steps ticked in black and the final step ticked in orange

phases.name: Launch & Evolve
phases.title: Deploy to Production. Keep It Working.
phases.body: We deploy without downtime, watch what the system does against live traffic, and keep tuning it as the business and the models change underneath it.
items: Telemetry, agent observability, and latency tuning
Model retraining, iteration, and A/B testing

image.alt: Launch and evolve: a flat app window on orange with a live indicator, three small trend tiles and a wide chart with an orange line rising steadily, beside a refresh symbol for continuous tuning
